🌍 Which of these extraordinary tribes amazed you the most?
The Bajau who can dive deep underwater, the Sherpa who thrive in the thin air of the Himalayas, the Rarámuri who run incredible distances, or the Inuit who survive in the freezing Arctic?
It's fascinating to see how human bodies can adapt to such extreme environments through genetics, generations of experience, and traditional ways of life.
👇 Tell us in the comments: Which tribe would you most like to learn more about, and why?
